correctness.rationale: Exactly normalized invariant-plane probability follows by integrating the two 2m-long extreme-vertex intervals over directions, total measure a+b+c. Strict Schur concavity follows from symmetric min-of-linear expectation with strictness on an open orientation set for unequal coordinates. The 48-sector spherical area integral gives the sharp cube probability. Tie-manifold coarea gives second derivative -J sum_ij(hi-hj)^2, where J=arctan(sqrt2)/(2pi sqrt2)-1/(6pi), hence the asserted C=2J for zero-sum directions. Triple tie neighborhoods are order eps^3. Deterministic checker independently confirms constants.

value.rationale: A complete sharp aspect-ratio extremal law plus an exact isotropic local stability Hessian for the canonical motion-invariant affine-plane section model. Distinguishes an inherently width-weighted probability from central-section statistics and quantifies the effect of anisotropy, of direct use as a stereological shape benchmark. This is not a claim that the cube-only probability or mean vertex count is new.
